brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Pair A is piece:0,0,0 and piece:1,0,0 (full hex bases). Pair B is piece:-1,0,0 and piece:-2,0,0 (full hex bases), in the same row.

requirements.requirement: The pairs are joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: The only join between the pairs is one side-connector-double on the shared edge between (-1,0) and (0,0). Each pair's internal edge also carries a side-connector-double (-2,0|-1,0 and 0,0|1,0), so no other fixing is used. check_build reports no errors and meshClash clear.
capOpenFaces added 18 solid caps on the open faces; lockJoints applied. No issues remain.

finish.summary: Built a row of four full hex bases at (-2,0), (-1,0), (0,0), (1,0) on level 0, grouped as two pairs: {-2,-1} and {0,1}. The pairs meet only through a double side connector on the edge between (-1,0) and (0,0). Each pair is also joined internally by a double side connector. Caps and joint locks were applied; check_build is clean with meshClash clear. Note: the two pairs are edge-adjacent in the row, since a connector can only sit on an edge between two bases; I did not leave a gap between them.

- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
